title: GitHub Organization Policy & Dials Schema
description: Validates organization-level configuration dials (Tier 2) in config/orgs/<org>/org.yaml against the GitHub Enterprise baseline.

name.description: Display name of the GitHub Organization.

description.description: Purpose and domain scope of the organization.

billing_email.description: Billing and administrative contact email for the organization.

default_archetype.description: Default repository archetype applied when a domain or repo does not specify one.

security_dials.description: Organization-level member privilege and GHAS default dials. Note: Public repo creation (false) and SAML SSO (true) are Tier 1 locked baselines.

members_can_create_private_repositories.description: Dial: Whether organization members can create private repos outside IaC (Default: false).

members_can_create_internal_repositories.description: Dial: Whether organization members can create internal repos outside IaC (Default: false).

members_can_fork_private_repositories.description: Dial: Whether members can fork private/internal repositories (Default: false).

web_commit_signoff_required.description: Dial: Require contributors to sign off on web-based commits.

dependabot_alerts_enabled_for_new_reposi.description: Dial: Automatically enable Dependabot alerts on new repositories.

secret_scanning_enabled_for_new_reposito.description: Dial: Automatically enable GitHub Advanced Security secret scanning on new repositories.

secret_scanning_push_protection_enabled_.description: Dial: Automatically block pushes containing detected secrets across new repositories.

actions_dials.description: GitHub Actions workflow execution and token governance dials.

allowed_actions.description: Dial: Restrict reusable GitHub Actions to selected trusted patterns or local-only.

allow_github_owned_actions.description: Dial: Allow actions authored by GitHub (actions/*, github/*).

allow_verified_creator_actions.description: Dial: Allow actions authored by GitHub Marketplace verified creators.

default_workflow_permissions.description: Tier 1 Baseline: Default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions must be read-only.

can_approve_pull_request_reviews.description: Tier 1 Baseline: GitHub Actions workflows must not be allowed to approve pull requests.

sha_pinning_required.description: Dial: Require third-party Actions to be pinned to a full-length commit SHA.

default_job_timeout_minutes.description: Dial: Default workflow job timeout in minutes (Allowed bound: 15..180).

repository_defaults.description: Organization-wide default branch protection and merge dials applied unless overridden by archetype or repository.

default_branch.description: Standard default branch name across the organization.

min_reviewers.description: Dial: Default minimum required approving reviews on pull requests to main (Allowed bound: 2..5).

dismiss_stale_reviews.description: Dial: Dismiss stale pull request approvals when new commits are pushed.

require_code_owner_reviews.description: Dial: Require review from CODEOWNERS when matching paths are modified.

require_last_push_approval.description: Dial: Require approval from someone other than the last person to push to the PR branch.

require_conversation_resolution.description: Dial: Require all PR review conversations to be resolved before merging.

runner_groups.description: Self-hosted or GitHub-hosted Larger Runner groups at the organization level.

visibility.description: Dial: Restrict runner group access to selected repositories (recommended) or all private/internal repos.

allow_public_repositories.description: Tier 1 Baseline: Public repositories can never use organization runner groups.
